idio_only_minimum_risk.derivation: Zero expected returns and zero factor loadings reduce the objective to minimum idiosyncratic variance. Inverse variances 25 and 11.11111111111111 normalize to 9/13 and 4/13; portfolio variance is 0.027692307692307693.

active_factor_cap.derivation: Without the factor cap, the 10 percentage-point return signal pushes the first asset to its upper bound. Its single loading is 1, so |factor exposure| <= 0.4 implies w1 <= 0.4; the constrained optimum is therefore [0.4, 0.6].
